strips.title: A cold week with a rechargeable warmer — in real life

panels.head: Flip it over
panels.text: Read the model number on the bottom and match it to the list before the first charge.

panels.head: Charge while awake
panels.text: Use the cable it came with, on a hard surface, and stay nearby (CPSC battery advice).

panels.head: Keep a layer
panels.text: Glove or pocket between warmer and skin; low heat burns over hours.

panels.head: Retire it right
panels.text: Swollen or hot when off? Stop. Batteries go to hazardous-waste drop-off, not the trash.
